Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly treated “Cleveland Elementary School” as “Cleveland Park” and assumed the nearest station was Cleveland Park on the Red Line. This name-confusion led to concluding there was no direct route to Reagan National Airport (Blue/Yellow), yielding “0” stops. In reality, Cleveland Elementary School (DC) is near Shaw–Howard University on the Green/Yellow alignment, which provides a same-line route to DCA, so the “no direct route” conclusion was wrong.
